text:
This was the rudest experience I've ever had at any establishment bar none. I walked in with three of my friends and both of the bartenders were rude to each of us individually. We were snapped at that it was last call at 11:30 (just walked in) when google and yelp say you close at 1 AM. One told us they have been working all day so they were tired and one said she was new. Ok sis? What's with the attitude? We all get it no one wants to be a bother but why not update your google maps like the other thousands of establishments that have to managed to keep their stuff together during these strange times. They charged the wrong credit cards no one was pressed but they stayed attacking all of the clientele - who trained these people?!

Beware of angry aggressive white men wearing "CRACKER LIVES MATTER" shirts who will try to start shit with anyone who is a person of color (not that there was anyone else there non white). MAD RACIST VIBES. MAD BAD VIBES. NEVER going back fair warning it's the twilight zone in this place.

Hands down the best place in the area for pizza and cheesesteaks. Their wings are also awesome as well. I have never had anything bad from this place and they keep their dining area immaculate. Pick up is a piece of cake as well. Friendly staff As well that keeps me and my family coming back. This place is a hidden gem that anyone in the area needs to check out.

I'm not sure if anyone reads these for McDonald's but I felt the urge to leave one here. The store is so horrible from the time you pull into the drive-through to the time where you pull out where it makes you never want to visit another McDonald's again. It was around midnight on June 2, 2018 and as I pull up to the drive-through, the guy working the window says "what do you want?" Like no "thanks for stopping in" or "welcome to McDonald's", just "what do you want?" Like this is why you work at McDonalds because you have no desirable skills. No hospitality or customer service skills at all! Or maybe the guy just doesn't are about his job because his pants were halfway down his legs with his fro flying everywhere, no hair net or anything. Like c'mon McDonalds. You're one of the biggest FF chains in the world and you're telling me this type of employee is the best you can do? Doubt it. Is there any training or anything for any position within McDonalds? Doubt it. The manager here is failing their store and employees terribly. He needs to be let go as well as the window guy. This store always has a problem. Ice cream machine is down, rude AF employees, no standards and always forget something. There's another location on seventh and keystone. I would recommend going to that one because this one is a huge disappointment. Being in the food industry for many years, I can tell you this store should hire better employees or people who are at least friendly and want to be there.


UP

I've told my high school son not to go there anymore for lunch as they apparently charge STUDENTS only 18% gratuity. That's bs. They shouldn't serve students if they're going to treat them like that :-(

Nice little gem hidden away from busy Dale Mabry. Biscuits are made fresh. I had the Squawking Goat and wife had Biscuits and Gravy (I think they call it Ralphie). We had a side of fried green tomatoes which were actually thick cut  We both really enjoyed our food. Prices were competitive.
We'll definitely be back.
Bianca is amazing ;) we always have great service here and the atmosphere is amazing!
Horrible. My family spent $70 on their Chinese food. Waste of money. Chow mein noodles were mushy. Fried rice has absolutely no flavor. Worst Chinese I've ever had!

I ordered a small almond milk tea with boba online for pickup. They called to confirm they had my order correct because I accidentally put that I wanted "only boba" and "only coffee jelly beans" and not both; and they kindly notified me they were out of coffee jelly beans BEFORE I got there! The person on the phone was extremely friendly and patient. As soon as I arrived, they texted me saying my order was ready with really cute emojis and instructing me to text back letting them know I was there for pickup. As soon as I walked up to the window, they handed me my drink in a bag. I now have them saved to my contacts because I will be going back to Corner17 often! Last, but not least, the boba was just how I like it. I made my sweetness at 75%, which is what I'd recommend; anything more might be too much. Also, their boba is very firm and chewy, and the almond flavoring is nice and potent!

Visiting Philly for the first time, we walked in and bellied up to the bar on a Saturday night at around 830. The host was perfectly lovely. It was hopping, but not inaccessible. The cocktails are complex and tasty, and the sake selection is great. Our bartender was curt but efficient and talented. We counted ourselves lucky, because we watched the other bartender flip (rather than hand) a menu to a neighboring patron who requested one. In response to a question from another patron, the same bartender replied, "Did you look at the menu I gave you?" I get that it's a stressful gig, especially when there are only two of you. The drinks are time consuming (Espresso! Egg whites! Fresh brewed tea!), and drinkers can irritate, but I saw no one earn the attitude dished out or the studiously avoided eye contact.

I like me some korean food. With that said, Arario is more fusion than authentic korean but their flavors are pretty spot on! While I tend to prefer the more traditional dishes on the menu, there's definitely something unique and interesting that would please any palate. I love their variety of banchan and the bimibob bowls. And dare I say they have the best kimchee in town? Some of the unique dishes I really enjoy are the porky pops and the chicken wings! The sweet and spicy sauce they put on the wings is amazing! We most recently enjoyed a take out meal from Arario and they did a nice job of packing the food up so that it was fresh and flavorful upon arrival. If you're looking for some adventurous but also familiar eats while in midtown, this is your place!

So my roommates and I always Postmates Rosepeppper (and go there) every week. I've been SUPER bummed at their service the past few orders (and so have my roommates) because the order is always wrong or missing something. Postmates itself is expensive in charges and it's not like I can get my driver to go back and pick up the correct order. When I report back to Postmates that my order was incorrect, sometimes they don't fully refund me for the meal I ordered. 

I specifically wrote THREE times in all caps no beans for my order because I'm allergic to them. They did all the sour cream and flour tortillas that I wrote along with it, but completely ruined my meal by putting beans on it. My roommate ordered the other nettos and they forgot to give her guac. I tried to call to let them know because this keeps happening with our orders (this is the second time with the bean situation) and no one picked up. Love Rosepepper, but can't afford their mistakes on Postmates.

My family and I have been ordering pizza from the Santucci family for over 55 years.  I am not sure what is going on at this location but the last three times from this location both take out orders and eating in this location the pizza has been very dry.  I have always thought it is the best pie around but not lately from this location.  There must be something going on between the family members because it seems each location is doing something different to their pies.  I don't mind paying for a good product but when it is sub par and expensive that is not good enough for me.  Different family members own and run different store's and it seems the best location right now is one that is run from a franchised location.  Boy do I miss the pizza from Mom and Dad Santucci from the old O street store when they used to cut the pepperoni in about 4 inch strips on a pie.  I don't even thinks the family running the business today are old enough to remember that.  Very disappointed from the store on 10 th street especially since I have to travel from Jersey for a pie.

the food changed! i used to love the pho that had all the bok choy, now there's tofu. the tofu in the bahn mi and steam buns is a different consistency (maybe missing a sauce or something?) as well. this place is still a gem, but i miss the old cooks

Horrible food ! Horrible service and way too expensive! Paid 35.00 for curry dish , fried won ton app and 1 beer.they even charge for simple white rice!!!!! Never again will I eat there ! Rip off for terrible food! I wouldn't even give them 1 star rating . Avoid this place if you really know good service , good Thai food and reasonable price . I was pissed off when I left ! Never ever again!!!!

I so wish I could give this location more stars, but honestly I considered making it a two. Giving them to break. On our visit, they were slow and confused. They weren't exactly personable and it was anything but fast food. Maybe they were just off their game on this day, but for their sake, I hope they get it together.

This place is soooooooo slow.  It's drive thru only.  Two days ago, I ordered one coffee ahead of tine on the app.  Got there 10 min later and there was no one else in line.  Pulled up to the pick up window and it still took them at least 5 minutes to hand me my black coffee.  They literally had to just pour from the pot into the cup and put a lid on it.  And this is not the only time where I experienced their slowness.

Didn't received what I ordered. Shrimp I was allergic to asked for chicken. Called to get what I ordered. The staff were nice by trying to let me keep the shrink but I'm allergic. They sent out the chicken it came burnt so yeah probably won't be ordering from them again.

Pleasantly surprised at this Sonny's.  We came after a fishing trip and during covid times, indoor seating establishments were limited and thankfully we stumbled upon Sonny's.  This location had plentiful parking and was newly renovated compared to the other architectural style.  The service and food were surprisingly good - it had been a while since I last stepped into a Sonny's.  We ordered the family platter and had plenty of food to take back with us.  The pulled pork and ribs were excellent.  The brisket and smoked chicken were okay, not the best.  The sides (mac n cheese, cole slaw, and fries) were very tasty!

Will stop by here again.

Went to stock and barrel our first night in Nashville. It was an amazing atmosphere, the drinks were good and the food was even more amazing. I had the bacon cheeseburger which had bourbon infused bacon on it. Was cooked to my preferred temp and was still just as flavorful and juicy. Would recommend this place to any new visitor to the area.

So many things to love about El Berraco. For one, it's designed inside and out to resemble a submarine. That's so fun in the desert! The food is amazing. The house salsa is pale green but don't mistake it for tomatillo--it's Caribbean-pepper based and its bright, roasted flavor is unique and addictive. 

Our dishes were ceviche-esque with shrimp, sliced scallops, and tuna. All were incredibly fresh and perfectly seasoned.

The service was impeccable with several staff checking on us throughout the meal.

The tomatoes in my order were not fresh. They had a spoiled taste to them, and it made me question everything else I was eating :(
Hopefully, this was one time thing. This was my first time eating from Down The Hatch. I might try it again, but Juan's Flying Burrito is just blocks away, and it's always phenomenal.

Must visit local institution for po boys, no glitz or glam just HUGE sandwiches in a friendly atmosphere.

Food: First off these sandwiches are HUGE! Secondly, they are down right the best po boys I've had during my (2) visits to NOLA. We tried the Half & Half Seafood ($18) & the Fried Shrimp w/ Swiss & Roast Beef Gravy ($16) sandwiches. No ketchup on the Half & Half but plenty of hot sauce! The Fried Shrimp w/ Swiss & Roast Beef Gravy has a lot going on, good but its not for everyone. Definitely have the Half & Half Seafood. One large sandwich is honestly good for (2) people.

Service: We were helped by the nicest of sandwich ladies during our visit. Sandwiches are ordered at one counter, beer and soft drinks are ordered at the adjoining counter for some reason.

Location: Just a 10-15 min uber ride away from the hustle of Bourbon street. Hot tip - Check out Magazine Street on your way back, lots of small/fun shops to see.
Just stopped along our road trip on the coast and enjoyed delicious ahi tacos and mahi tacos! Loved the decor, nice outdoor patio.  Delicious food, great service!

Awesome find! Stopped in for the first time and was not disappointed. The food was great, everyone was friendly and helpful. They gave us free dessert for my birthday as well. I would highly recommend the seared sea bass sliders to anyone, even if you don't normally eat fish!

They are accepting reservations online and spacing all customers out for safety, everything seemed clean and we were comfortable.

Chef panda is the best. Foods is always great! The place could use a fresh coat of paint and maybe some decorations outside lol. Don't let the exterior fool you because the inside is gorgeous. We've come here many times and ALWAYS have a wonderful time!
Food and drinks are great, the atmosphere is even better. Moderately priced and totally worth it!
Visiting Boise we found this awesome lunch spot. Great selections and super fresh items. We enjoyed the homemade soups and dressings. The service was great. We ate there twice in two days.

We loved it! We were visiting and staying close by, so I made reservation there the first evening. We enjoyed it so much, we went back on our last night. Both times we brought our kids and sat on the comfortable front porch, which was fantastic. I almost always order beet salads, and the one here was delicious! My 9 year old was converted to a Brussel sprout lover and the carrots were excellent. We thought all the vegetables were inspired, and for a nicer restaurant I thought the portions were on the generous side. I enjoyed the service, local neighborhood ambiance and delicious food!

This is a little known place is a great Italian gem. I have driven by here so many times and not bothered to stop. Now I am so glad I did. The atmosphere is cool but not super comfortable for lounging and talking. Chairs are super uncomfortable. Good wine, beer, and coffee product menu. Our server was polite and efficient. A good selection of pastas, pizzas, and paninis.  I decided on the gnocchi with pesto and my friend went with the panini. We also decided to split the bruschetta. All food came out in a timely manner.  The bruschetta was beautiful and plentiful. Just the right amount of garlic. My gnocchi was amazing! The little pillows of dough were soft and the perfect texture, and the pesto sauce was fresh and vibrant.   My friend enjoyed her panini. I will be back to try the pizza!

Restaurant was great and food was great.  Service was not!  They close 10:00 pm on Sunday.  We came in at at about 8:15 pm!  Waitress was clearly pushing us so that she could get out early.  Really disgusting!  I would have left her a 100% tip because of pandemic but she continued to drive us crazy, even while we were eating our main meal.  Please don't ask your customer about desert while eating your crab legs!  Unbelievable.  Hey can't work until ten,  then don't work!  That simple!

Tampa has another Chinese bakery called Fortune Star, but it doesn't have as diverse bakery options. Sweet Buns is a self serve setup for efficiency & you can even order soup! The best part? You can leave with a whole lotta delish Chinese baked goods for only a couple bucks each & not restrict yourself because everything is well-priced (take advantage & try different yummy goods)!

CHEESECAKE 5/5: Light, very fluffy and a different twist in that it's not as sweet compared to Western dessert; it is a marriage between NY cheesecake & angel food cake - brings back a lot of childhood memories (this is really one of my fav. desserts to indulge in)!

FLOSS BREAD 5/5: Do you prefer something more savory? I always get this - the pork was the perfect amount (you get a lot!) with a buttery inside that was sweet (another go to of mine - so delish)!

SPONGE CAKE BUN 3/5: Drawn to the purple color (ube/taro?) - least exciting to me because it tasted dry to me (I only ate half as a result).

I like the bagels, breakfast and lunch sandwiches are both good, but the service is extremely slow and inconsistent. Definitely do not go here if you have time constraints. I recently watched who I believe to be a manager do everything except help customers in a growing line. I think the problem must be a lack of staff, but I am a fairly regular visitor and this never seems to change.

Usually My favorite Taco Bell. The location is great and my food is usually good. However recently they stopped giving away water cups and tried to charge me the price of a soda. Ummm, I'm pretty sure it's illegal not to offer free water to your customers. At the very least you should only charge the cost of the cup, which when I worked at Taco Bell was 10 cents. Charging me $2+ for a cup of water is ridiculous. Honestly enough to lose me as a customer. I'd rather eat at any of the competing vendors or drive an extra 5 minutes to a different tbell if it means I can drink some water.

Street tacos seem to be all the rage. While there are more good options around the Indianapolis area than some would want to admit, these are some of the best we have had. Good amount of protein per taco when compared to other locations, and by far my favorite chorizo taco anywhere. 

The interior is pretty basic, but enough seating so that it is more than a to-go stop. 

Worth a stop if you are in the area!
Not the best sushi but Tues night is $6 rolls and that's cheaper than grocery store sushi and better so it's the Tues joint if you're not too sushi snobby

Can't say enough about this place. Atmosphere was great. The chicken was prob some of the best I've had. Mac was delicious and baked beans were good. The fried okra was out of this world. Will def be back again and again. Oh and the staff is very friendly.

The 4 star average is based on two separate visits.  Actually, one visit and one carry out.

We'd done a carry out back before they had reopened, and while the food was good, service was dismal from the person taking our order to the one bringing it out.  I realize times were very difficult then, but it was difficult for consumers, also.  A little politeness would've gone a long way.

After the sting of that experience, to be fair we went back for dine in a week or so ago.  It was like it was an entirely different staff...and it may well have been.  Everyone was friendly and professional.

The happy hour specials were great and fairly priced.  We shared some sashimi that was stellar, I had their sliders and, they too, were stellar.  The patio is a fantastic place to people watch on a summer evening.

I'm glad we gave them a 2nd chance.  We'll return based on that visit.

Service was phenomenal and the food/drinks were great. The environment is second to none. I thoroughly enjoyed my time at the outside bar. So much so that I came back again for a second time in the same night. I highly recommend this place.

Ordered for takeout and found everything to be really good. Ordered 2 single patty burgers with American cheese, lettuce, tomato, and red onions. Also, an "our own" burger which is more specialty ie sauce etc.  In addition 2 orders of fries and an Oreo milkshake. All really good, just as I would expect burgers to be. 

Minus one star but not their fault. A post game Skadium crowd came in to order, loud and largely without masks or wearing them below the nose.

I was so excited when coming in to see the sign that said, mask required, you won't be seated without them, and after we were seated, a table of for his were seated with NO MASKS!!!  If you are not going to enforce your own rules, what good are they, take the sign down then!!!

Came here for dinner with my boyfriend for Valentine's Day and it was AMAZING!! The decor was so unique and awesome, every staff member we interacted with was so friendly, and the food was soooo good! Maya was our server and she was so kind and took great care of us. The fried chicken is to die for! And they make their own hot sauce which is so cool, and very tasty on the chicken.  The brussel sprouts we so tasty, too! I can't wait to go back!

Used to be my favorite sushi spot. Close to home and food WAS good. Don't know if it is under new management or what but they have been so crappy to me the past few times I've ordered and the food has been less than so-so. Gonna find a new sushi spot because they have been seriously slacking.

THIS PLACE IS THE SHIT!!!!! Omg I got the Uncle
Tony and I'm gonna say that was the best sandwich I've ever had. I'm not even done eating it and I want another. Poe is the best, super fun dude. I'm obsessed 20/10

Great pizza, slow delivery though. 
If you're gonna order here, just pick it up. We ordered deliver three times here over a few months and it's always been past the hour and 20 min promised time. Not a huge deal but, when you're hungry you're hungry. 
Pickup is way faster, when they say it'll be ready in 40 minutes, it's ready in 40.
Very crowded but they were able to seat us in the patio. The food was so good & great service! The restaurant is so beautiful...a must see!
awesome customer service, quick and pleasant takeout!! love chopstick express, best chinese in town

The truth is this is a terrific place. I don't think I would've survived quarantine without them they've been a constant comfort. My favorite is the company combo we substitute the tomato for pineapple, then my husband picked off the pineapple and I eat it. It's a thing. Anyway we love this place it's terrific.

I sat on this review since the 29th of July. Before writing it, I wanted to get some things cleared up so I had accurate information and I had justifiable cause to write it.  Chefs in Davidson County are required to wear face masks when preparing your food. This coming directly from the Mayor's office and I have attached the screenshot for confirmation via a Facebook message.

I decided to come here for dinner and grab some food for takeaway. They have their covered patio for where people can stand and place orders through a plexy glass covering that engulfs an entire wall. They have menus outside for you look at before placing your order. Currently, the do not do dine-in. initially when placing my order for a chicken bento box that 

I paid for in total $26.93 before my $4.00 tip, I did not notice that the sushi chefs were not wearing masks. It was about 7 minutes after the fact that I noticed they weren't. I approached the window and asked the man who had taken my money if he could cancel my order and give me a refund. He said he was not going to give me a refund as the food was already being made. He offered a discount. I said I wanted a refund. I expressed that I did not feel comfortable eating the food that was being made because of their lack of masks. 

The man who I was speaking to was the assistant manager, Lucas. Lucas went back and forth with me on the matter. He said he was giving his employees a break from wearing the masks since they were not in contact with cus

Every time I go to arigato, I leave more than satisfied. The owners are so kind and appreciative of everyone that comes in and it feels like a family. The sushi is incredible along with the mochi desert. The presentation of each dish is beautiful and thoughtful and the service is absolutely premium. Their new outdoor seating looks lovely and there are tons of heaters. I recommend calling for a reservation due to the restrictions right now and they were VERY busy on a Wednesday night!!! I expect nothing less though, because this place is just fabulous. Thank you always arigato and staff!!!
I have never found a place that made brussel sprouts that I liked .. This place made them and I LOVED THEM. Pork was juicy and delicious.

I take my pizza very seriously. And this is seriously good pizza. One of the best chain, fast casual pizza places out there. This location and chain is new to the Boise area...my 14 year old daughter was so so so excited that we landed one here. We've eaten at MOD in other cities and states and it's so good. 
A couple things....get the mega dough, it's just a little bit more price wise, but it's a great option, especially if you're going to share your pie. Another is....pile it on. You can add as much as you want with make your own at no extra charge. And if you see from my photos, add the broccoli. At first I was like, broccoli on pizza?! No way, but the sweet gal making my pizza recommended it and I'm so glad she did. It is awesome. Stellar customer service, delicious pizza, great prices, fast, warm, friendly. YES MOD!

NY giant pizza sits right in the plaza where the movie theatre is. I ended up eating there 2 or 3 times while I was in Boise. The staff were friendly and the service was quick. As far as the food goes the slices are huge. The pizza itself was pretty good but not the best I've ever had. I'd rank them above average for taste.
It's always good no matter what time you go. They should get rid of the tables against the window considering you can't sit there and it takes up space for people to wait for orders.

Have you ever driven 80 miles round trip for something only to find out you're missing parts when you try to assemble? Have you ever tried calling an 800 number over the course if hours only to get a prompt saying "sorry, can't take your call" (followed by a dial tone)? Have you ever really felt shafted? No? Then you really otta shop at Ikea.

We came here with friends whom had came this week. We're visiting from Northern California. I was initially excited. The service was friendly & accommodating. We sat outside. 
Another friend had this same pork chop and we agreed ... it was too well done, the collard greens were so salty as well as the potatoes. The waiter said the cook seasons the food. I could not eat the collard greens or the potatoes becuz it was way too salty. Ugh! I drank 3 glasses of water then said to the others I'm done. Maybe they hope you'll order more beverages.. but I would not recommend this place. I was extremely disappointed as where others. By the way, I love collard greens but spoil a good thing? Yes they did with that and the pork chop!
Sorry NOLA...Northern California cuisine 
Is the best!

This place is so delicious. 

We had the goat cheese (?) appetizer. Amazing. 

We had the fungi pizza. It's amazing. Add the two condiments they bring with it. I forget what they're called. One is red and one is green. 

We had the trout. It was very, very good. 

We had the dessert. The popular one. It was good. I wasn't blown away. But it was good. 

My only complaint is that it's so dark in the restaurant.

Had my birthday dinner at Husk (which happened to be my first time dining there), and boy was I not disappointed. The staff was accommodating and our server had such a stellar personality and even joined us for a slice of cake. We all left happy and full of scrumptious food -- the sliders & beef tartare that night were perfection.

Best empanadas ever. Not greasy at all. We had the caprese and the hongos empanada with the chimi papás. Absolutely amazing. Their homemade coconut and dulce de leche alfajor is the best way to end the meal. This is our second time here, and we are coming back for sure.
It was extremely cold. Like 40 degrees in July. Also the workers where on their phones and didn't care about what they where doing.

A shadow of its former self.. Used to be an elegant place with fabulous food, and terrific service. . It no longer is that. It's a factory now with bad, impersonal service., and not good food. We saw our waiter twice during the meal, and was served almost entirely by the not very well trained assistant. Gone are the white table cloths, fine wine is served in like catering glasses. The food? The gumbo ya ya was completely inedible- really just bad . I had three spoonfuls and when they cleared said nothing about the full bowl. The BBQ shrimp were fine, but seemed to lack the depth of flavor that they used to have.  

It's been a staple of our visits to New Orleans since the early 90's and I'm sorry to say our last. There are way too many better options than to eat at a restaurant resting on their laurels.

I had Ricks for the first time last week and will definitely be a returning customer. First win is that they deliver to Sparks. There are very few local pizza restaurants that deliver by us. Food arrived on time and was hot. The cheesy breadsticks were delicious and kept well. Our two pizzas, wolf pack and triple r were also wins. Triple R took home the top prize. We also had potato skins but they were just ok, probably wouldn't order them again.

The food here is always fresh, always delicious, generous portions and servers who really know what they're doing. I've had an omelette with fresh spinach for breakfast and a veggie sandwich for lunch. Excellent preparation. And I always pick up a container of kimchi on my way out.

First time here.  All I can say is outstanding.  Mike and Katlyn were perfect.  The even ordered up the perfect sunset for my girl friend.

Peggy the had pear salad.  I had the filet.  The steak was as good as Ruth Chris or better. Both were outstanding.

This is a place you will want to come back to again and again.

I arrived on a Sunday around 11am and had to wait for around 1.5 hours before getting seated. You can order drinks from a "bar" table outdoors while you wait, so at least you can have something to do while you wait. My group actually went for a bike ride along the shore while we waited. Chad's uses Yelp waitlist so you can easily check your place in line and the estimated time from your phone.

Once I received the notification our table was ready, we got seated right away.It seems like we were the tail end of the brunch crew because there were so many open tables right after we sat down (maybe around 12:30-1pm). 

I saw on Yelp they give free muffins for tables so I was excited for those. I noticed the tables around us all had muffins but our table was missing them! I asked a server and he said unfortunately they ran out of muffins for the day. He did say if I come back he will make sure I get extra muffins. Not sure how that would work, haha!

The mimosa flight was 10/10; highly recommend. Star of the show. You get 4 different mimosa flavors so there is bound to be some or multiple you like. I didn't love the cranberry one but my friend did so I traded her for the peach one so I had 2 peach mimosas instead. Super cute and tasty.

I ordered the corned beef hash after studying the menu for a long time. There were a lot of great options to choose from! It was quite tasty but ketchup made it even better. 

My plate came with eggs and toast (standard for brunch places) but I thou

Extremely bad service. Meat was completely Raw when I bit into it and the food was not corrected by the kitchen at all for a long time we just asked for it to be taken off the bill. And not authentic dimsum. They did not have signature dimsum dishes like shrimp rice noodle roll. The selection of the menu is very limited. Ive tried every place in Chinatown for dimsum and this place has been the worst. This place is very overrated. The line to wait was not worth it at all.
Awful, go to L'Angolo. This place's lights never stop flashing and they yell at customers

Tommy our waiter was awesome he was nice with the kids and he made sure we was taken care off. This was a family// Anniversary dinner and Tommy made is special . I will definitely return to this Outback. Food was amazing

Food was tasty but they only gave me half an order.  Really disappointing. We ordered 3 stir fry's and each order had an issue. I drove all the way from Montgomery County to come get some food only to get home and be left not completely satisfied.

Went here for lunch when we were vacationing in New Orleans. The drinks and entrees were innovative. We hope to come on a weekend to try the dim sum brunch or dinner. The cured meats look delicious. The service was attentive and the place had a cool vibe. Had the noodle dish but it could have been spicier. We will be back next visit.

My favorite go to spot. I have not had a bad experience since my cousin told me to go here 7 months ago. One of those places I always ride pass and never went in.The customer service  brings me back and the food keeps me there. I order royals at least 2 to 3 times a week not including the days my husband brings me lunch. I always stick to my usual fried chicken, corn pudding,  mac and yams, n  ice tea. I'm a foodie and it takes a lot to keep me coming back and I keep coming back ..so 2 thumbs up. -Martina J.

Came here, like many people, for a delicious meal while visiting NOLA. The experience was great. Beautiful space with outdoor eating, wonderful service, delicate touches everywhere. The food is also delicious - from the labneh to the hummus to the cauliflower and salads to the mains - it's all great. Perhaps the best part was the tea; the hibiscus flavor is memorable.

Nothing here though is eccentric, unique, creative. It's standard upscale Mediterranean food. I enjoyed it but ultimately left wanting a little more.

The food didn't taste great - it seemed like all of the seasoning was in one place, not distributed. The meals tasted very fishy despite there being no fish in the dish. Overall, it doesn't seem fresh.

This is one of the worst place I've had the misfortune to eat. They ran out of menus, seriously? They ran out of cornbread, again seriously? Our waitress never took our drink orders and after waiting for 1/2 we asked another waitress to take our drink and food order. Someone in my group asked for pink lemonade and got pink water. Our food was cold & it tasted ok. I will never eat at this establishment again. I gave it 1 star since I was unable to give 1/2 star
Winkel is doing awesome breakfast/lunch/brunch now in Center City. Cool space with  friendly and warm service. My current fav is the pear and brie omelette.  Great addition to Wash West!
Nice people. Fast service. Nice outdoor seating. No hassle as I loitered and enjoyed the air

Decided to go for a healthy option after the Temple basketball game. The salads were very good at this location. I normally get one of the noodle bowls from HG, but opted for a salad this time. The Golden Curry salad had a very nice flavor, was fresh and unique considering its main green was kale. I enjoyed the blend of curry and cauliflower that helped offset the bland taste of kale. I added chicken for the protein which helped. My wife ended up enjoying the Cobb Salad. We tried all their organic drink options and the best one was the tea. The service took a little long since the salads are made to order and most people get the stir fry bowls so it was expected. I never have a bad experience eating at any HG and would recommend you check it out for a healthy and delicious option. One interesting tidbit about this location is the company's founder is a fellow Temple U alumni and they happen to mention it in the decore. It's great knowing a fellow alum is responsible for a successful chain.
Ordered a Margharita Pizza minutes before their closing time. They were kind enough to accept the order. Pizza was good.

I've been here several times before but always late at night for the club upstairs. I was curious to try their food and happy hour so I can evening. Happy hour is from 4 to 7 which is longer than some places. They feature half-price appetizers and two dollars off drinks. The bartender really seemed to be too busy to take care of the 10 people that were at the bar. I had to flag him down each time I wanted to order something. The crab dip was decent, about the same as when I've had other places. We also had the jerk wings and taco Tuesday special. I enjoyed the oxtail taco and I've certainly never had one before. The drinks tasted like straight juice but I felt A buzz after my second one so I guess they were just well-made. Overall the food didn't impress me at all. I really wanted to try a jerk chicken cheesesteak but they said they were out of it and then served one to the person a couple seats down from me 15 minutes later. I was also surprised that there is no whole fish on the menu which is rather unusual for a Caribbean restaurant. I think from now on I'll stick to going to the club here.

From the time I sat down my waitress was at my service. Smiley girl willing to help me with suggestions.I ordered the Southern Charm burger but switched up the cheddar cheese for bleu cheese. It made it popwith flavor! Mixed it with sweet potato fries...couldn't get much better. I'll be back on my next Tampa trip!
Absolutely delicious!!! Had the Pho Beef Stew, and it hit the spot. Great service too! Fast and friendly.

I don't know how anyone can give less than 5 stars for this place! 
The Saint Charles stack is soo good! And I get a side of cheese grits as a flavor combo. Then of course I wash it down with a vanilla latte! 
 
This place is basically my Sunday tradition!

Keep in mind that they are popular here..  so be a lil patient and get a latte while ya wait for your grub! You won't be disappointed!!

Austin was probably the most amazing server I've ever had! He knows the menu, makes helpful suggestions and is friendly and fun. He definitely enjoys his job! He's thoughtful and helpful. We enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Lots of vegetarian options. Try the pie. Dawn Marie came over to add more fun to our outing. She suggested the seasonal blueberry pie which was delicious. Also set us up to look forward to peach pie coming out soon. The prices are very fair for the area. We got caught there during a rainstorm and didn't even mind hanging out a bit longer. I went to the original when I was a kid and didn't remember it so it was nice to see it's back. They are family friendly and there is outside seating. Pets are welcome
Absolutely delicious and great price!! Their ice coffee is so yummy and the waitress was nice and understanding. The service and food is a 10/10. I would go back in a heartbeat.
Doesn't compare to The Persian Room in terms of quality.  Service is excellent, but meat isn't as good as the Persian Room. Of course, prices are lower too.

First time in. Had high hopes.  Turkey burger was decent and good sized. After that all downhill. Fries which I read about as something to look forward to were really bad. I ate about 3 and threw the rest away. Apparently they were cooked way earlier and were old and stale. Also ordered a portobello spud, as I read they were good. It too was bad. Just bad. A few bites in and saw the spud was over cooked, mushrooms were okay, but overall it was a below average spud. So the silver lining is I can check it off the list of places I wanted to try. No need to return.
The pizza's decent but add a half hour to whatever they tell you for delivery and make sure you preheat your oven because it WILL be cold without fail. I'm definitely done with this place.

I had an amazing experience at this restaurant while visiting some friends in the area. The service was on point. Our waitress was knowledgeable about the menu and made some great suggestions. The food really impressed me especially the muscles! If you are in this area looking for quality Italian cuisine make sure you try this Bertucci's

I always love trying local places!! I have driven by so many times, and I have wanted to try this place out. I took my husband and 2 kids today. Sunday's are typically busier most places so I was trying to stay optimistic!!

First impression walking in: super cute!

However wasn't greeted, and waited for at least 10 minutes before anyone acknowledged us. The two people working were working! So that's understandable but a simple hello we will be right with you is easy to do while busy!

Okay so a few pieces of advice:
On busier days like Sat/Sun maybe hire 1 more person! The two that were working were doing their best but we were there for over 35 minutes. We ordered the Baja Burrito and the Monster Burrito. Too slow sadly!
 Greet people when they walk in.

Most likely won't return soon, I just didn't get that wow factor.
The food was good though Minus the egg shell leftover we got in the burritos- oh well! I hope they get a few more friendly employees to help out.

Fantastic food and service! Stopped in for dinner tonight and could not have asked for a better experience. We ordered the beef satay, bua Loy dumplings, khao piak zen soup (our favorite dish of the night), curry and poached banana in coconut cream (order it, thank me later). Everything came out quickly and the ingredients were really fresh (they also make their own noodles for the soup). We'll definitely be back!

I just had my son's rehearsal dinner here on September 27th. Everything was just amazing! Thank you to Brittany, the banquet manager, the wait staff, and the chef. The room and menu presentation was simply perfection. Highly recommend booking special occasion dinners here !

Best desi food in Philadelphia 

Just try their achari biriyani 

And thank me later 


They are the best
Love this place especially the rib tips. The deviled pig is a lil piece of heaven it's a southern bbq twist on the devil crab that is stuffed with spicy shredded pork on the inside!!

Honestly, just pick anywhere else. After waiting over an hour at our table for our side salads to arrive, they came out wrong. The server dropped a ranch dressing which got all over me. Our calamari came out before the salads and was soggy from sweat sitting in the window. The plate was scolding hot and the sauce had congealed from the heat. Everything fried was stuck together. The manager was a whole entire jerk. Another server who saw everything unfold even said he didn't handle it well and blamed his lack of customer service on...... rain. On top of allllll of this, we sat next to the kitchen and expo, the other manager chewed out a server right in our earshot. JUST PICK SOMEWHERE ELSE.

17 years later, we revisited the Black Pearl for our anniversary dinner, the place that was the start  of our evening before the man of my dreams asked me to be his partner in life.
You would think that a fancy 10-15 (max)  restaurant wOuld recognize this celebration. Nope. In fact, our wAiteer was less tHan interactive or nice. He was funny and cordial to the table of 6 regulars (read, older, probably richer), but not us. So overall, servicE was meh.
So did the food make up for it?
Did the atmosphere (ceiling tile old and stained, furniture original)?

On both accounts, I must say no.
Lobster risotto was OK, I cOuld have pulled it off in my own kitchen. The fIsh, OK, the beef also just underwhelming. The pork  belly app Waac phenomenal, not offered to us, not on the menu, thank you  yelp for having such great reviews for me to inquire about.

Deferred desserts as it seemed that would have annoyed our server , the night wasn't madE special, so we out...

I had the gumbo it was sub par at best. Than we order the stuff shrimp it was terrible. Maybe this place is known for its oysters but I will not be returning. It was not a good choice for my first New Orleans food experience

I was very excited to try the enchiladas based on the yelp reviews. But literally they took a stack of maybe two or three corn tortillas, threw some green sauce, sour cream,  and a little bit of cheese on top. How is that even an enchilada? I will admit that the guacamole was good. But when Chipotle is better even for the basics like chips and salsa, you know I will not be going back

This is the best restaurant in Indy for that special night!  From the friendly hostesses when we first arrived, to our great waiter Michael who made wonderful menu suggestions, to the food (1st course-sea trout; 2nd  course- roasted carrots with a mint pea purée; 3rd course ricotta gnocchi and chicken rolled with Swiss chard; and fourth course-ricotta donuts (maple glaze with brown butter ice cream)).  The atmosphere was lively yet civilized.  The wait staff was very friendly.  A totally enjoyable time!  Recommend Vida highly.

Amazing food, I went there today to get to-go and it said 1:55 was the time to be there, I get there 10 minutes early and stand outside for 10 minutes and no one came to the carry out window.

After that I walk inside and the girl behind the register was too concerned with talking to the kitchen staff.

She eventually comes over and I say my name for the order and she says "oh yes, we're just waiting on it now"

It's now been 45 minutes since I ordered online and there are 6 people that have been in line for the 20 minutes I've been here.

My 2nd favorite cheesesteak spot in the city because: 
1) efficient service
2) great consistent taste

Today I got a cheesesteak with whiz and fried onions and a side of fries. It was adelicious, hot, and quickly made. What else is there to say? Steve's is good at what they do. 

I went at 12PM on a weekday and they still did a great job! The steak is left in whole pieces and seasoned just right. Most Philly cheesesteak shops chop them up but that's not always a good look. Steve's leaves all of the fixins on the side fir you to choose at your leisure. If you see this as a disadvantage think again because this option empowers you to choose any amount of pickles, sweets, hots, ketchup, etc you want.

You order fries at a separate window to maintain the shops efficient flow. This place is a win-win and I always know that I'm getting quality products when I go. I recommend any of the 2+ shops I go to. #HastyFoodiePic

I had never heard of or seen this place before so I can honestly say it was a pleasant surprise when it popped up in a Yelp search. I ordered a ALT (avocado, lettuce, tomato) on multigrain bread. It was delightful. There was an entire avocado on my sandwich, which was fantastic. I was so pleased with my order and they served me fast as well. I was also glad they had different breakfast food options for those of us who do not eat processed meat, don't eat eggs, and are carb conscious. Thank you iMunch, see you again soon.

Who goes to a coffee shop while on vacation and orders kombucha? Me. 

In my defense, I don't drink coffee even when I'm at home in the Bay Area. Plus, I happened to have a sore throat and the beginnings of a cold. That said, Stumptown saved the day with a refreshing glass of kombucha and a number of different hot teas. The barista at the front register heard me commenting about finally finding hot tea in the South, instead of a bunch of sweet tea, and she recommended Mammoth Espresso, too.

There are tons of different seating options inside since Stumptown is adjacent to a hotel. I really enjoyed the relaxed, cozy vibe.

Small assortment of seemingly fresh pastries from croissants to blueberry muffins.

This was just across the street from the AirBnB we were staying at and would make a nice pit stop on one's way into the French Quarter.

Awesome! Great setting for group. It's kind of outside but still covered and shady. Snack and salad menu was nice. Love the soft pretzels. Perfect with beer!

With all the new beers, it was easy to find a tasty one. I enjoyed the limited edition harvest reserve! It was a real surprise,  in a great way!

First meal of my bachelor party was here on Friday night and what a great way to start off the weekend in Nashville. Love the vibe inside, it truly showed off what Nashville was about with all the things to appreciate hung up on the wall. As noted by the name, this place serves all things pork. I personally got the pulled pork sandwich and it was delicious. The homemade coleslaw complemented the sweetness of the meat and tied the sandwich together. The pork ribs were also tender and I was able to just pull the rib out and enjoy the meat. Highly recommend this place as the wait is not bad and it is simply delicious food.

I saw this was voted number one cheesesteak on Yelp.. I have to be honest this was at best an average sandwich. The local pizza places have better cheesesteaks. Forget about the Tony Luke's of the world that specialize in them. Not sure what all the hype was about. It wasn't horrible but it is what it is.. it's a local deli that makes a cheesesteak.

Came in for lunch and had to wait just a few minutes for a table. It's really small inside so be prepared if there might be a wait. I couldn't decide between 3 different items so our server, Danielle?, said okay, she knew just the thing I would like. I was surprised by a wonderful chicken stack sandwich which is a fried chicken filet with homemade pimento cheese and fried onions on ciabatta. It was amazing. Also, the fries are particularly good with just the right crisp. Portions are huge so if you can't take leftovers you might want to share with a friend. Thank you, Danielle and Destiny!

I have been accused to being the big easy so it was a pleasure to find my sister in crime ~ the Little Easy.  I think it was the right time for the right mood.  I was in a fancy hotel and ready for some typical New Orleans fare (poboys) without the richboy price.  I was not sure whether it had more of a dive bar feel than a restaurant but either way the lunch hit the spot and I was pleased with my find.  This is in the emerging warehouse district so you can load up on carbs before you hit the galleries.

Fried Grouper Sandwich was soooooo GOOD! We also got a steak salad that was juicy and warm and absolutely full of flavor! I definitely recommended getting those hush puppies; unlike anything I've ever tasted. Don't be afraid of outside appearances, the place has a cute, charming interior and the staff were so sweet. If you have the opportunity to pass by, you gotta stop here!

Lalalalove lola's! We got the XL seafood paella and shared it amongst 5 people, and had the ceviche and the calamari as appetizers. I would have liked if the seafood in the ceviche were a bit more acidic and sharp, like the original ceviche is like in Peru. The calamari was interesting, as it was served as a block, and cut criss cross. Loved the flavor and texture, super on point! The seafood paella was just mouthwatering. Loved every bit of it! These three dishes were the perfect amount to share for us, definitely will be going back.
If you are familiar with Korean bbq then this place hits the spot. The combo is the best bang for your buck. Service is on point. Highly recommend.

We went to bahama breeze for lunch. Service was very poor. The server forgot half our drinks and there was no cutlery till we asked for some. We packed some beef empanadas to eat later. Unfortunately got VERY VERY SICK with food poisoning. Terrible night. Was on multiple meds. Won't be going here again.

We love Panda Express for and have been so excited to have one near us, so we finally got around to coming right before 6pm tonight. We pulled in the drive up and told it was closed due to being short staffed. Ok - I understand! However, we watched two more people pull in behind and be told the same thing, then we parked and I stayed in the car. . . Only to watch the fourth car, and following cars get served in the drive through. . . No more than three minutes after we were told "Sorry, we can't help you. Come inside." There were no cars but one parked in the parking lot as I sat in the car waiting for my husband. My husband counted 7 people inside working. I work in the restaurant industry and find this to be very unacceptable customer service. If the drive through is closed, then close it with a proper cone. But if all of your customers are driving up to order in the drive through, then recognize where the business is, and be fair and open for all.

I like Neapolitan pizza. So that's #1.  

Fiamme is now take-away only. I walked in, and as a new customer they did a great job of orienting me to the menu options. I ordered the vegetarian and it was delivered to my car in almost the exact time they quoted. Thanks for that. 

Thoroughly enjoyed the pie, the fresh topping, and the crust. looking forward to my next visit.
Staff was unfriendly. Food overpriced & over rated. Ordered a chicken sandwich thought it came with fries. Think again. Almost $7.00 just for a sandwich.

They cancelled our order after waiting for 1 hour for it for delivery.  We had 4 people waiting.
They had no reason.
They're terrible.  Don't order from these guys.

This is a quaint little restaurant on Gandy blvd.
Very nice ambience, there is live piano music in the evenings. Open for lunch too. Food is made fresh .
I had the eggplant parmigiana, very happy with it.

Met some friends for drinks and dinner at Rococo in St Petersburg, FL.
Lounge was welcoming, bartender was talented (loved the cosmo and my friends were very happy with their martinis).  Quiet, welcoming ambiance.

The dining room was intimate and well appointed.  My friends both had Aged KC Strip while I selected the 7 oz filet.  We also had grilled asparagus and truffle fries.  Our wine selection was a wonderful Pinot Noir from the Oregon Coast.

Our dinner was unhurried, enjoyable and memorable.  We will definitely return.

My go-to for a fast burger. Heck, even beats a lot of the "fancy" burgers  around the area. I used to live in NYC and frequented the Shake Shacks there. This location is consistent with the NYC burgers. Curbside pickup is well coordinated.

Love this place, first time at this location and the music was on point and the food was awesome. The servers bri and drea I think was very courteous and made me and my family feel really comfortable ordering, they made sure we was ok every step of the way. Will definitely visit this location again !!!

Great ambiance  to start. The staff was especially friendly. Food took a bit long but all was very good. Had the chefs choice prime rib. Perfect cut with minimal fat. 

Prices very good for quality of food and service

Love this place for a quick sit down meal. Street parking in the front and a small parking lot in the back. Kind of grungy in the inside, but the food comes fast and the service is good. They have a bar inside and a bar out back on the patio. I love the chicken nachos and I like to get the half and half (you choose a sandwich and a soup that comes with chips) my usual is the club and potato bacon soup.

Not sure what is going on with this place.... was Ijji Sushi then closed down for a few months for "remodel" reopens as the noodle house but looks the same inside. The menu is kind of difficult to figure out and seemed a little hodge podge. Unfortunately the service was horrible. They brought us our food each separately by like 10 minutes each?!?! Yes that actually happened. My husband got his ramen first, ten minutes later I got mine, we waited another ten minutes for the rest of our party to get their food then asked "what is up?" They were apologetic and finally brought the other two dishes after ours were no longer warm. The staff was apologetic and comped us a couple of beers. Despite the inconvenience, the food was actually better than we had expected , or maybe we were just starving by the time we got our food. I would give this place another try.

The manager Stephanie is so rude... the food is great but you can't even find anywhere to sit with all tables filled with kids using their laptops drinking only water? Are you serious?? I'm calling Corporate later to complain... WORSE MANAGER EVER

My spouse and I were looking for something different and local for dinner. We've heard great things about this place and to be honest we are not experts in Indian cuisine.( I also have to say we ordered thru yelp as a pick up so we couldn't get explanations for every menu item we looked at) We gave it a shot and the food is really good. We had the chicken tikka masala which was not too spicy but we chose mild instead of a higher spice level. It does come with rice however the description on the menu doesn't say that so we ended up ordering more rice. We also had the veggie samosas and mmmmmm they are delicious! Wonderfully spiced and crispy.  The naan bread is also super fresh and delicious coming in a variety of flavors as well. I'm only giving 4 stars simply because we haven't tried enough of the menu and I believe the menu could be more specific as to what is included with each entree. However we plan on returning to try more items on the menu.

CHIPOTLE CAVEATS 
1. Queso: You can add cheese to any item free but Queso costs $1.25 more - which is very deceptive
2. Guacamole: is an odd $2.05 add on
3. Chips: have a funky lime flavor which seems weird for a place trying to be somewhat natural
4. Cilantro & Red Onion: not offered (thought that was an authentic preparation?)
5. Meal Deal: not offered

I heard this place had amazing vegetarian options and decided to give it a try. I was extremely impressed with their meatless options and enjoyed my fair share of appetizers. If you're looking for a meatless entree that tastes like meat, try this place out! 

I decided to rate this bar/restaurant three stars because we had drink tickets and i went with a dirty martini (my all time favorite) and it tasted like straight tap water. It was the worst dirty martini I ever had in my entire life. To say i was disappointed is an understatement.  

Come for the food, stay away from the bar.
OMG so delicious! I will highly recommend to anyone visiting the area to eat here. Great customer service, friendly staff and quick service...WE LOVED IT AND WILL DEFINITELY RETURN!

I absolutely refuse to go to this McDonald's. They always get my order wrong. No matter what I order I'm told to drive around the corner and wait for my food. It doesn't matter what time of day or how busy they are. Isn't that what the second window is for, so I can pick up my food after paying. The employees have gotten attitudes with me several times when I have tried my hardest to be cordial, and understanding. I hate this McDonald's with a passion, and will drive past them to spend my money at the taco bell next door anytime. They have less than a two star review on here! The only reason they still get so much business is the convenience of their location. Yelp let me give a no star review, but they deserve it.

My favorite restaurant in the entire city. When I die, please bury me here. 
I always order half chicken.

After a long day in the Clearwater area weather it be at the beach or amenities surrounding, I would highly recommend going to Crabby's for lunch/dinner. The parking is a bit scarce due to it being located directly across from the beach. They do offer parking passes for $2 for 2 hours which I found to be an awesome deal. This gave my family and I the chance to wander around the beach worried free of my meter running out. Like a majority of the restaurants on the beach for the most part their menu is entirely seafood...if you're an odd ball like myself and don't prefer seafood they do offer in land meals such as chicken, steak, etc. the service was quick and easy and very accommodating for those that do visit from the beach. They offer indoor and outdoor seating as well as bar seating. Don't get me started on the food, and that delicious key lime pie!! It is a bit tart but like I said I am odd and have a unique acquired taste but it was still delicious! Thank you to all at Crabby's for being so attentive and providing the best service out there.

Our family was in town, so we treated ourselves to Guido's. This restaurant never disappoints. The food was amazing, as was the service. Our our of town family was really impressed, to have a 'Taste Of The Hill', while in St. Louis. We had Lasagna, Canelloni, Chicken Picatta, Pizza, House Salad and a plate of mixed appetizers. We highly recommend them all. Everything was wonderful and the prices are reasonable.  Lately, We order food to go, and we are so happy the dining room has reopened. Thanks so much.
Absolutely worst service I've ever had anywhere, I work in the service industry and the girl waiting on us is the worst waitress ever. If you don't want to work please stay home!

Old City, Phila is full of overpriced, bougie bars & restaurants. Nicks is a little slice of heaven for the atmosphere, service, food, and wallet. Big fan of the French Onion soup, Italian egg rolls (prosciutto, provolone, long hots), wings - everything is made with care and delicious. Can't beat their bucket beer specials. Always Philly 4 phaithful supporting our teams.

So, I'm going to be honest. This place is a mess. They opened for a week and suspiciously closed. Why lie and tell people it was your liqour license? It was poor management fair and square. Not to mention elitist and rude.My wife convinced me to try it again last week, so we went to the small Cafe. The employee was nice enough but double charged me. Which I'm still waiting on my refund. Took a long time trying to run my card and had no idea how to make a cappucino. My wife got chai milk. It was 97% whole milk. Fine, you had a stressful day. So we went back today and tried the restaurant. They ignored us for a good 15 minutes before we were seated. Our server was lovely, super attentive and sweet. I ordered the Spring Pasta and my wife ordered fish and chips. The food was fine, took an hour to get to the table but fine. Let me leave it at this, while I understand its harvested from the greenhouse out back, you have got to calm down. $18 for one singular fried fish and soggy fries. $23 for a vegetable pasta. No meat. It was not bad food but are you kidding me? I left still hungry after paying around $50.
Very good food. The service was fresh and fast. I expected a little bit larger pieces of Grapes and nuts in one of the chicken salads but otherwise good.

This is the best grocery store closest to WashU. It's wide selection of foods and delicacies and it's convenient location make it the grocery store I visits the most. The packed cooked food they sell are tasty and in good quality.

I can't believe I have never actually written a review for this place. It is THE BEST bagel shop in the city. I think it may actually be my favorite place that I have ever bought bagels from. The bagels are so fresh every time I go, whether that be during COVID or before, and the service is always spot on. The egg and cheese is absolutely unreal. As someone who is an incredibly tough judge on eggs, these are perfection in a bite. I'm happy I don't live closer or I'd be eating here everyday.
Had a great lunch sitting outside today and a great server Lexi. Awesome service and the salad was super fresh. Looking forward to returning soon.
My server Nicole was amazing. She was so nice, funny, and sweet. Great experience! The food was really good. I met a really cute bird named Peggy/George and Nicole and I had fun. Yaaaaaaaaasssss!!!!!

Poor response when we called to complain that our order was incomplete.  Argued with us that the entree was in the bag.  Bag was stapled shut so we didn't check each item.  Would have been nice if they apologized and accepted that they made a mistake.   Food was fine but many better Chinese restaurants in the area that will provide better service.  We won't order from here again based on the rude response.

Great food.  Fresh wonderful flavor. Ordered the fajitas. If you want lots of veggies and amtiny bit of meat look elsewhere. My plate came with plenty of meat to fill my 5 corn tortillas and plenty for Leftovers. Yes there were peppers and onions mixed in but predominantly was meat. Refrained beans and rice rounded out the meal. They offer curb side pick up which is great.  Fast, friendly. And food is delightful.  Will be back

I've been here many of times before COVID-19 which they have some of the best chicken wings in Indianapolis, and Brothers Bar & Grill had a good wing deal I believe it was in Wednesdays. Now, when I went there Saturday November 28th very quiet, must wear a mask of course, no one can sit at the bar anymore, less staff members, they don't pass out the menus anymore, you must scan the barcode on your smartphone. There's a lot of social distance tables as well as booths, the booths does have a clear divider between each booth. I used to love ordering the 10 delicious honey bbq wings, but the wings they used to have isn't on the menu, bummer? I know. I ordered the traditional sweet BBQ wings which only comes out in 8 instead of 10. I remember going to Brother's Bar & Grill it was always so loud you couldn't hear your friend talking. It felt slightly good that it wasn't loud, and I actually could hear when someone was talking to me. Also, the staff members were wearing masks, and I noticed the hand sanitizer stands.

I spent my lunch dining at superior grill with two of my girlfriends. When I came previous years, it was a pleasant experience, but I cannot say the same for this visit... To begin, our waitress had the most unpleasant attitude- she was not welcoming or friendly to my friends and I. She acted as if we were a burden to her! Next, we were throughly disappointed with the entrees. The only saving grace of the meal was the overpriced queso! I ordered what I thought was going to be traditional nachos. I instead received six (6) singular tortilla chips with beef and globs of cheese on it- I could have made this in my microwave at home for a fraction of the price. These "nachos" were not worth $12.. One of my friends ordered a chicken and cheese quesadilla, or if we should even call it that. The "chicken" was pink and appeared undercooked- NOT edible! However, my other friend ordered a beef and cheese quesadilla, and this was actually decent. Thank goodness! Although I enjoyed attending this establishment previous years, I do not think I will be dining there again.

my wife and I went to the whitehall, pa. location 9-11-2019 and had dinner.  The waiter was pleasant, and she ordered the prime rib, and I ordered Flos filet. Our salads were fine, and my wife's prime rib was fine.
My filet was so tenderized it felt like liquid mush instead of steak. Never had a filet that obviously was tenderized, to the point of melting in your mouth.  no texture or the natural grain of the steak. Filet cuts are naturally tender when grilled, and I will never get one at Long Horn again.
The sweet potato was good, and I just wanted to tell you, It was a very expensive waste of a steak.  I ate it, did not complain, but my experience was not good expecting a steak that was not tenderized. 
I will not order another one.

Excellent, as always.  We got carry out which I now kinda prefer to eating in.  Like if I eat in I just get to try 1 or 2 different things because I don't wanna drag leftovers back to the office but this time I ordered a ton of stuff and just took it home and now I've got leftovers for the week.

Things I got that I hadn't tried before:

That said, the curry puffs that came with our order traveled well also, were still nice and crispy.

I was hesitant to write such a negative review for a place I've been here dozens of times. I reliably go here for bibimbap but unfortunately, this is happening. I've been here in person before and I loved the decor, miso soup, and selection of sauces. So I decided to order off UberEats. I don't know what happened but my meal was pretty subpar. 

When I order tofu bibimbap, I expect the carrots to be shredded. Instead, they just threw in 4 baby carrots in my dish. That's a little odd. Along with that, the broccoli and cauliflower were just not cooked at all. I could be mistaken but I think those are supposed to be steamed. Lastly, there was no egg, spinach, or cucumber. Those vegetables are advertised in the UberEats selection yet they are not there. This was extremely lackluster.

Not only that, but my friend, who ordered the japchae meal only got 1 baby carrot. If you do not have the proper ingredients, please list it somewhere. Make the menu item invalid. Just don't let me order it only for us to be disappointed. 

I do like this place. I'm sad I had such a bad experience this time around. This experience was 3 stars, but due to my numerous good experiences, I decided to put 4. Hopefully, next time will be better!
